{{Otheruses|Chief of State}}
The '''Chief of State''' was the title of the co-leaders of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during and after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] held the position in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]; [[Dur Gejjen]] later took the reigns after Sal-Solo's [[Death/Legends|death]]. [[Denjax Teppler]] was one of the Co-Chiefs of State in [[43 ABY]].
